origine_fr: L'autel 礻 : le malheur, ce que les esprits refusent. À droite, 呙, 口 sur 内, donnait le son ; il se lit guō, loin de huò. L'autel dit que le malheur venait du ciel.
origine_en: An altar, 礻: misfortune, what the spirits hold back. On the right, 呙, 口 over 内, gave the sound; it is read guō, far from huò. The altar says that misfortune came from heaven.

phrase.fr: Il a eu un accident de voiture hier.
phrase.en: He was in a car accident yesterday.
